# Contributing to TRTT VoyageHub & Roksana Boutique

Thank you for your interest in contributing to the **TRTT VoyageHub SuperStore & Roksana Nila Boutique** repository!

This project is dedicated to providing high-speed, transparent travel utilities, consumer rights assistance under European law (EC 261/2004), and authentic Bengali boutique fashion.

---

## Code of Conduct
All contributors and participants are expected to adhere to our [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Please treat all members of the community with utmost respect and empathy.

---

## How Can You Contribute?

### 1. Reporting Bugs
- Search existing [Issues](https://github.com/Cocvghuj/Cocvghuj-trtt-news-bot/issues) to verify if the issue has already been reported.
- If not, create a new issue using our **Bug Report** template.
- Include reproduction steps, browser/system specifications, and screenshots if applicable.

### 2. Suggesting Enhancements & New Tools
- We welcome suggestions for new travel tools, flight deals calculators, and design improvements.
- Open an issue using the **Feature Request** template.

### 3. Pull Requests (PRs)
- Fork the repository and create a descriptive feature branch from `main`.
- Adhere to our existing clean coding patterns (HTML5, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, and Python 3.11).
- Ensure all affiliate links maintain the approved tracking marker: `787950 LOCKED`.
- Run local builds (`npm run build`) before submitting to verify that files in `dist/` compile cleanly.
- Submit your Pull Request detailing your changes.

---

## Editorial & Content Guidelines
- **E-E-A-T Compliance:** All travel articles and logistical insights must reflect genuine field experience and consumer transparency.
- **Privacy (GDPR):** Never commit personal contact data, customer orders, or credentials into public files. All sensitive values must use GitHub Secrets.
